proposals.evidence: The addendum specifically treats Western Pahari Kiunthali cīn and Kotgarhi cɔ̈̄n under the trīṇi branch, explaining the cī oblique through *trihi and the rounded forms with Middle Indo-Aryan *trao influence. These Kullui cīn/coṇ survey forms match that regional palatalized nasal-final series; the r-retaining forms are kept separate.
